Proposed query:

```sql
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY JV_default_PCE DESC) AS rank,
  printf('%.2f', JV_default_PCE)  AS PCE,
  printf('%.3f', JV_default_Voc)  AS Voc,
  printf('%.2f', JV_default_Jsc)  AS Jsc,
  printf('%.3f', JV_default_FF)   AS FF,
  COALESCE(Perovskite_composition_short_form,
           Perovskite_composition_long_form)            AS composition,
  Perovskite_thickness                                  AS thickness_nm,
  ETL_stack_sequence,
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(REPLACE(ETL_stack_sequence, ' ', '')) = 'SnO2'
      THEN 'pure SnO2'
    ELSE 'bilayer/multilayer'
  END                                                   AS etl_type,
  HTL_stack_sequence,
  Perovskite_deposition_procedure                       AS deposition,
  COALESCE(Ref_DOI_number, Ref_ID)                      AS paper
FROM devices
WHERE Cell_architecture = 'nip'
  AND ETL_stack_sequence LIKE '%SnO2%'
  AND JV_default_PCE > 5 AND JV_default_PCE <= 30
  AND JV_default_Jsc > 5
  AND JV_default_Voc > 0.5
  AND JV_default_FF BETWEEN 0.4 AND 1
  AND COALESCE(Perovskite_composition_short_form,
               Perovskite_composition_long_form) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(COALESCE(Perovskite_composition_short_form,
                    Perovskite_composition_long_form)) <> ''
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(Perovskite_composition_short_form,
                     Perovskite_composition_long_form)) NOT LIKE '%nan%'
ORDER BY JV_default_PCE DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
